overview_description.description:
PatSnap is a connected innovation intelligence platform that provides IP and R&D intelligence. It is used by more than 10,000 customers in over 50 countries around the world to access market, technology, and competitive intelligence as well as patent insights needed to take products from ideation to commercialization. 

The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Singapore.

about_short_description.short_description: PatSnap is a software development company that provides intellectual property and research and development services.

product.name: Patsnap Eureka
product.description: An AI-driven platform for patent research, R&D discovery, IP protection, and technical problem solving using patent, scientific, litigation, and technology data.

product.name: Patsnap Analytics
product.description: An IP intelligence and patent analytics application for analyzing patent portfolios, technology landscapes, competitors, filing activity, and innovation trends.

product.name: Patsnap Synapse
product.description: A biopharma intelligence platform that connects patent, scientific, clinical, drug, and commercial information for pharmaceutical and biotechnology research.

product.name: Patsnap Bio
product.description: A biosequence search and analysis product for researching biological sequences, related patents, scientific literature, and sequence-based innovation.

product.name: Patsnap Chemical
product.description: A chemical structure search and analysis product for investigating compounds, chemical patents, related literature, and chemical innovation landscapes.

product.name: Patsnap Eureka Desktop
product.description: A desktop application that provides access to Patsnap Eureka’s AI-assisted research and innovation intelligence capabilities.
